name: When is the best time to widen a bathroom doorway during a larger renovation?

mainEntity.name: When is the best time to widen a bathroom doorway during a larger renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best time to widen a bathroom doorway during a larger renovation is typically during the demolition and framing stages. This allows for efficient integration of the structural work, rough carpentry, and any necessary relocation of electrical or plumbing lines before new drywall, flooring, and fixtures are installed. Performing this work early prevents disruption to newly finished surfaces and ensures that all accessibility requirements are met from the outset of the project. It also minimizes additional costs and keeps the overall renovation schedule on track.
acceptedAnswer.description: The best time to widen a bathroom doorway during a larger renovation is during the demolition and framing stages, before new finishes are applied.
